name_ar: الوقف على نون التوكيد الخفيفة المرسومة تنوينا
definition: When the light tawkid noon is written as a tanween with a fatha, stopping on it gives an alef. This happens in two words: وليكونا (Yusuf 32) and لنسفعا (al-'Alaq 15). Joined, the first is read with an idgham with ghunna before the meem that follows, and the second with a meem hidden with ghunna before the ba.
limitations: Paraphrase of the cited pages by an automated drafter; not scholarly reviewed.
Only Book A is cited; the printed page is where the section begins and needs proofreading.
The rule is about stopping on the word; this engine stops only at the end of an ayah or at an explicit stop word, so the note says what a stop would give.
A closed list in the Kufian numbering used by the book.
Second citation: the longer book Nabhan, which Book A digests. It agrees with the paraphrase, so it shows where the text is found, not an independent confirmation.
